title: Wild Flame
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Dust on the dashboard, miles to go
Your laughter lingers in the hallway

[Chorus]
Every heartbeat finds its rhyme
The rhythm of the wheels keeps time

[Verse 2]
Your laughter lingers in the hallway
Dust on the dashboard, miles to go

[Chorus]
Every heartbeat finds its rhyme
The rhythm of the wheels keeps time

[Outro]
The night is ours to keep
structure: Intro (4 bars) / Verse (16) / Chorus (16) / Verse (16) / Chorus (16) / Bridge (8) / Chorus (16) / Outro (4)
desc: A gritty techno song at 80 BPM in C# major, written by the Signature song engine.
